nodes.description: ERC20 private mapping (address => uint256) _balances tracking token balances
ERC20 private nested mapping _allowances[owner][spender] tracking spending approvals
ERC20 private uint256 _totalSupply of minted tokens
ERC20 private string _name set once in constructor
ERC20 private string _symbol set once in constructor
ERC20Decimals immutable uint8 _decimals fixing token precision
ERC20 public transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) forwarding to _transfer with _msgSender()
ERC20 public transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) using allowance mechanism
ERC20 public approve(address spender, uint256 amount) forwarding to _approve
ERC20 internal _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) moving balances
ERC20 internal _mint(address account, uint256 amount) increasing total supply and balance
ERC20 internal _burn(address account, uint256 amount) reducing balance and total supply
ERC20 internal _approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) writing allowance
ERC20 public increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) adding to current allowance
ERC20 public decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) subtracting from current allowance
StandardERC20 public decimals() override returning super.decimals() from ERC20Decimals
StandardERC20 payable constructor validating initialBalance_ and minting to _msgSender()
Context internal _msgSender() returning msg.sender
ServicePayer payable constructor performing external payment to receiver
ERC20 empty internal hook invoked before transfers, mints and burns
msg.sender user-controlled caller address used for minting and allowance accounting
_balances[recipient] += amount balance credit inside _transfer
_totalSupply += amount and _balances[account] += amount arithmetic inside _mint
IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) external call in ServicePayer constructor
_balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount subtraction inside _transfer
amount parameter shared by transfer, transferFrom, _transfer and _mint
recipient parameter used by transfer, transferFrom and _transfer
sender parameter used by transferFrom and _transfer
senderBalance local variable inside _transfer read from _balances and decremented
initialBalance_ constructor parameter of StandardERC20 used for the initial mint
currentAllowance local variable inside transferFrom read from _allowances

amount argument flows into ERC20.transfer
recipient argument flows into ERC20.transfer
transfer calls the internal _transfer routine
amount argument flows into ERC20.transferFrom
recipient argument flows into ERC20.transferFrom
sender argument flows into ERC20.transferFrom
transferFrom delegates the actual movement to _transfer
_allowances[sender][_msgSender()] is read into currentAllowance
currentAllowance - amount is written back through _approve

_transfer defines and assigns the senderBalance local variable

amount parameter used in the balance arithmetic of _transfer

amount is the subtracted operand in senderBalance - amount
result of senderBalance - amount is stored back into _balances[sender]
amount is added to the recipient balance
recipient is the key whose balance is incremented

initialBalance_ parameter is validated in the StandardERC20 constructor
initialBalance_ is passed as the amount argument of _mint
_mint executes the _totalSupply and _balances increments
_mint increases _totalSupply by amount
_mint increases the minted account balance in _balances
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before moving balances

_burn invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before burning

decreaseAllowance writes the reduced allowance through _approve

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only carries a value into the _transfer balance arithmetic and has no independent semantic identity.
The recipient parameter is only used as the credit target inside _transfer.
The sender parameter is only consumed by transferFrom's allowance and delegation logic.
senderBalance is a short-lived temporary that is fully subsumed by the _transfer balance update.
initialBalance_ exists solely to feed the constructor's validation and initial mint.
currentAllowance is a temporary snapshot of _allowances used only within transferFrom's approval flow.
